description: One app's day in one answer — the Today screen: purchases, trials and renewals from the connected sources, new reviews, rank and category moves against yesterday, new entrants above you, new in-app events, and yesterday's App Store, Google Play, proceeds and ads figures, each marked with the source it came from. `tz` makes "today" the user's own day.

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Istanbul (defaults to UTC)

name: get_today
